reviews.title: Update ruined everything
reviews.text:
I used to be obsessed with this app. I purchased the premium version to use it with my Apple Watch Ultra for CrossFit workouts. I used to be able to set up the timer on the app, then control everything from my watch during the workout. I could double tap for rounds or reps. But the reason this app was amazing was because  all the data would sync with my phone so I could see and analyze it after. It was incredibly useful to have that data for my training. I could see things like how many rounds I completed in an amrap. And how much time each of those rounds took me. And how much time I had left over. For a basic “for time” workout, I could also see my round splits. 

Ever since they updated the watch version to be able to set up the timer directly from the watch, all of that data went away. Nothing syncs with my phone unless it’s controlled by my phone to start with which I cant do in a CrossFit workout. Now it’s just a basic timer. I emailed with all of this and it took them weeks to get back to me, basically responding that they have no idea what I’m talking about. 

I hope they switch back to the old version. The new one is a waste of money.
